v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.la: Et os meum annuntiábit laudem tuam.
r.en: And my mouth shall declare thy praise.

full.en: Come * Let us glorify the Lord.

la: Iubilémus Deo, salutári nostro: præoccupémus fáciem eius in confessióne, et in psalmis iubilémus ei.
Quóniam Deus magnus Dóminus, et Rex magnus super omnes deos, quóniam non repéllet Dóminus plebem suam: quia in manu eius sunt omnes fines terræ, et altitúdines móntium ipse cónspicit.

Quóniam ipsíus est mare, et ipse fecit illud, et áridam fundavérunt manus eius veníte, adorémus, et procidámus ante Deum: plorémus coram Dómino, qui fecit nos, quia ipse est Dóminus, Deus noster; nos autem pópulus eius, et oves páscuæ eius.
Hódie, si vocem eius audiéritis, nolíte obduráre corda vestra, sicut in exacerbatióne secúndum diem tentatiónis in desérto: ubi tentavérunt me patres vestri, probavérunt et vidérunt ópera mea.
Quadragínta annis próximus fui generatióni huic, et dixi: Semper hi errant corde, ipsi vero non cognovérunt vias meas: quibus iurávi in ira mea: Si introíbunt in réquiem meam.
en: Let us joyfully sing to God our saviour. Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving; and make a joyful noise to him with psalms.
For the Lord is a great God, and a great King above all gods. For the Lord will not cast off his people: for in his hand are all the ends of the earth, and the heights of the mountains are his.

For the sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land. Come let us adore and fall down: and weep before the Lord that made us: For he is the Lord our God: and we are the people of his pasture and the sheep of his hand.

Today if you shall hear his voice, harden not your hearts: As in the provocation, according to the day of temptation in the wilderness: where your fathers tempted me, they proved me, and saw my works.
Forty years long was I offended with that generation, and I said: These always err in heart. And these men have not known my ways: so I swore in my wrath that they shall not enter into my rest.

v.en: Sing to the Lord, O ye his saints.

r.en: And give praise to the memory of his holiness.

text.la: Dóminus de cælo * prospéxit super fílios hóminum.
text.en: The Lord hath looked down from heaven * upon the children of men.

text.la: Qui operátur iustítiam * requiéscet in monte sancto tuo, Dómine.
text.en: He who worketh justice * may rest on thy holy mountain, O Lord.

text.la: Inclína, Dómine, * aurem tuam mihi, et exáudi verba mea.
text.en: O Lord, incline * thy ear to me, and hear my voice, my Lord.

text.la: Retríbuet mihi Dóminus * secúndum iustítiam meam.
text.en: The Lord will reward me * according to my justice.

text.la: Exáudiat te * Dóminus in die tribulatiónis. ‡
text.en: May the Lord hear * thee in the day of tribulation. ‡

text.la: Dómine, * in virtúte tua lætábitur rex. ‡
text.en: The king rejoices * in Thy strength, O Lord. ‡

text.la: Exaltábo te, * Dómine, quóniam suscepísti me. ‡
text.en: I will extol thee, * O Lord, for thou hast upheld me. ‡

text.la: Pater Noster dicitur secreto usque ad Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem:
text.en: Our Father is said silently until And lead us not into temptation:.

text.la: Exáudi, Dómine Iesu Christe, preces servórum tuórum, et miserére nobis: Qui cum Patre et Spíritu Sancto vivis et regnas in sǽcula sæculórum.
text.en: O Lord Jesus Christ, graciously hear the prayers of Thy servants, and have mercy upon us, Who livest and reignest with the Father, and the Holy Ghost, ever world without end.

benedictio.la: Benedictióne perpétua benedícat nos Pater ætérnus.
benedictio.en: May the Eternal Father bless us with an eternal blessing.

source.en: Lesson from the first book of Samuel

text.la: 1 Fuit vir unus de Ramáthaim Sophim, de monte Ephraim, et nomen eius Elcana, fílius Iéroham, fílii Eliu, fílii Thohu, fílii Suph, Ephrathǽus: 2 Et hábuit duas uxóres, nomen uni Anna, et nomen secúndæ Phenénna. Fuerúntque Phenénnæ fílii: Annæ autem non erant líberi. 3 Et ascendébat vir ille de civitáte sua statútis diébus, ut adoráret et sacrificáret Dómino exercítuum in Silo. Erant autem ibi duo fílii Heli, Ophni et Phínees, sacerdótes Dómini.
text.en: 1 There was a man of Ramathaimsophim, of mount Ephraim, and his name was Elcana, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliu, the son of Thohu, the son of Suph, an Ephraimite: 2 And he had two wives, the name of one was Anna, and the name of the other Phenenna. Phenenna had children: but Anna had no children. 3 And this man went up out of his city upon the appointed days, to adore and to offer sacrifice to the Lord of hosts in Silo. And the two sons of Heli, Ophni and Phinees, were there priests of the Lord.

body.la: Præparáte corda vestra Dómino, et servíte illi soli:
body.en: Prepare your hearts unto the Lord, and serve Him Only

refrain.la: Et liberábit vos de mánibus inimicórum vestrórum.
refrain.en: And He will deliver you out of the hand of your enemies.

verse.la: Convertímini ad eum in toto corde vestro, et auférte deos aliénos de médio vestri.
verse.en: Return unto Him with all your hearts, and put away the strange gods from among you.

benedictio.la: Unigénitus Dei Fílius nos benedícere et adiuváre dignétur.
benedictio.en: May the Son, the Sole-begotten, mercifully bless and keep us.

text.la: 4 Venit ergo dies, et immolávit Elcana, dedítque Phenénnæ uxóri suæ, et cunctis fíliis eius et filiábus, partes: 5 Annæ autem dedit partem unam tristis, quia Annam diligébat. Dóminus autem conclúserat vulvam eius. 6 Affligébat quoque eam ǽmula eius, et veheménter angébat, in tantum ut exprobráret quod Dóminus conclusísset vulvam eius: 7 Sicque faciébat per síngulos annos: cum redeúnte témpore ascénderent ad templum Dómini, et sic provocábat eam: porro illa flebat, et non capiébat cibum. 8 Dixit ergo ei Elcana vir suus: Anna, cur fles? et quare non cómedis? et quam ob rem afflígitur cor tuum? numquid non ego mélior tibi sum, quam decem fílii?
text.en: 4 Now the day came, and Elcana offered sacrifice, and gave to Phenenna his wife, and to all her sons and daughters, portions: 5 But to Anna he gave one portion with sorrow, because he loved Anna. And the Lord had shut up her womb. 6 Her rival also afflicted her, and troubled her exceedingly, insomuch that she upbraided her, that the Lord had shut up her womb: 7 And thus she did every year, when the time returned that they went up to the temple of the Lord: and thus she provoked her: but Anna wept, and did not eat. 8 Then Elcana her husband said to her: Anna, why weepest thou? and why dost thou not eat? And why dost thou afflict thy heart? Am not I better to thee than ten children?

body.la: Deus ómnium exaudítor est: ipse misit Angelum suum, et tulit me de óvibus patris mei:
body.en: God, Which heareth all, even He sent His Angel, and took me from keeping my father's sheep, and

refrain.la: Et unxit me unctióne misericórdiæ suæ.
refrain.en: Anointed me with the oil of His mercy.

verse.la: Dóminus, qui erípuit me de ore leónis, et de manu béstiæ liberávit me.
verse.en: The Lord That delivered me out of the mouth of the lion, and out of the paw of the bear

benedictio.la: Spíritus Sancti grátia illúminet sensus et corda nostra.
benedictio.en: May the grace of the Holy Spirit enlighten all our hearts and minds.

text.la: 9 Surréxit autem Anna postquam coméderat et bíberat in Silo. Et Heli sacerdóte sedénte super sellam ante postes templi Dómini, 10 Cum esset Anna amáro ánimo, orávit ad Dóminum, flens lárgiter, 11 Et votum vovit, dicens: Dómine exercítuum, si respíciens víderis afflictiónem fámulæ tuæ, et recordátus mei fúeris, nec oblítus ancíllæ tuæ, dederísque servæ tuæ sexum virílem: dabo eum Dómino ómnibus diébus vitæ eius, et novácula non ascéndet super caput eius.
text.en: 9 So Anna arose after she had eaten and drunk in Silo: And Heli the priest sitting upon a stool, before the door of the temple of the Lord: 10 As Anna had her heart full of grief, she prayed to the Lord, shedding many tears, 11 And she made a vow, saying: O Lord, of hosts, if thou wilt look down on the affliction of thy servant, and wilt be mindful of me, and not forget thy handmaid, and wilt give to thy servant a man child: I will give him to the Lord all the days of his life, and no razor shall come upon his head.

body.la: Dóminus, qui erípuit me de ore leónis, et de manu béstiæ liberávit me,
body.en: The Lord That delivered me out of the mouth of the lion, and out of the paw of the bear

refrain.la: Ipse me erípiet de mánibus inimicórum meórum.
refrain.en: He will deliver me out of the hand of mine enemies.

verse.la: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
verse.en: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

text.la: Reliqua omittuntur, nisi Laudes separandæ sint.
text.en: Skip the rest, unless praying Lauds separately.

text.la: Deus, in te sperántium fortitúdo, adésto propítius invocatiónibus nostris: et, quia sine te nihil potest mortális infírmitas, præsta auxílium grátiæ tuæ; ut, in exsequéndis mandátis tuis, et voluntáte tibi et actióne placeámus.
text.en: O God, the Strength of all them that put their trust in thee, mercifully accept our prayers, and because through the weakness of our mortal nature we can do no good thing without thee, grant us the help of thy grace, that in keeping of thy commandments we may please thee, both in will and deed.
